fullContent:
Shringyadi Churna 
 Reference: Sharangadhara Samhita, Madhyam khand 
 INTRODUCTION 
 Shringyadi Churna is an herbal formulation in a powder form and it is not a very complex preparation as It comprises of a blend of three herbs. It is very helpful in curing fever, cold, cough and vomiting in kids. 
 INGREDIENTS 
 
 Shringi (Pistacia intergerrima) 
 Prativisha (Aconitum heterophyllum) 
 Long Pepper (Piper longum ) 
 
 METHOD OF PREPARATION 
 Clean all the herbs and grind them separately to form fine powder. Now combine all three powdered herbs and sift them with the help of a muslin cloth to rid of any coarse materials. 
 DOSAGE 
 ½ – 2 grams twice a day after food with 2- 3 grams of honey. 
 INDICATIONS 
 
 Cold 
 Cough 
 Asthma 
 Dyspnea 
 Fever 
 Disorders due to aggravated Kapha 
 
 CONTRAINDICATIONS 
 
 This formulation has no reported side effects. 
 Over dosage should be avoided. 
 It should be taken under medical supervision. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
